summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc reporting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting. The filing contains voting results for 31 resolutions, including election and re-election of directors, ratification of auditors, approval of remuneration reports, and authorizations to allot shares and purchase own shares. All resolutions passed. There is no transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or other special situation disclosed. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no event-driven catalyst.
